summary: Modernize the website UI to match the professional theme of the admin panel, ensuring fonts and UI elements remain readable across all theme/color combinations (accessibility/contrast).
architectural_notes: Establish a consistent design system between public site and admin panel, including theme tokens and accessibility/contrast requirements for typography and UI components.

existing_features.title: Update the global design tokens and typography so the public site has a modern, professional look consistent with the admin panel, while keeping all styling driven by semantic Tailwind token colors (background/foreground/card/muted/accent/etc.) rather than hard-coded one-off colors.

Ensure text and UI element contrast remains readable across theme/color combinations by auditing and adjusting foreground/background pairings for key components (buttons, inputs, cards, badges, nav/header, tabs/menus) and providing accessible defaults for both light and dark mode.
Modernize the public-facing layout styling to match the admin panel’s professional feel (header, footer, and landing hero/sections), while keeping existing navigation and page content unchanged.

Align admin panel theme readability by validating each existing admin theme option (goth-black, silver-steel, white-luxury, deep-purple, fire-red) maintains readable text and UI contrast for admin panel components and theme switcher states.

new_feature_requests.summary: Update public site styling to a more modern, professional theme consistent with the admin panel, with readable fonts/UI across all themes/colors (contrast/accessibility)

projectName: Modernize public site theme to match admin panel and ensure readable typography across all colors
